# GuessWord

> GuessWord (guessword.games) is a free daily word guessing game played in the browser. Players guess a secret five-letter word in six tries, using color-coded tile feedback. No download is required; a free account saves progress, streaks, and group memberships.

## How it works

- Each guess must be a real five-letter word; players get six tries.
- Green tile: the letter is in the word and in the right spot.
- Amber tile: the letter is in the word but in a different spot.
- Gray tile: the letter is not in the word.
- After four guesses without solving, a hint with a short clue becomes available. It never reveals the word. In Infinite mode hints are free in the Stone and Iron tiers and cost 1,000 coins from Copper up.
- Players earn 10 coins for every solved word (Daily or Infinite) and can buy more (3,000 coins for ₹10). Coins have no cash value.

## Modes

- Daily: one word for everyone, changing at midnight UTC. Solving it extends the player's streak.
- Infinite: unlimited rounds that earn points on eight tier leaderboards, from Stone to Diamond. Meeting daily targets moves players up; missed days move them down. Never affects Daily streaks or stats.
- Groups: friends join with an eight-character invite code and rank on daily and weekly leaderboards.
